description: Java Spring MVC controller class for serving images, including content images and product images, with methods to handle image retrieval based on URL parameters.

classes.name: ImagesController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for serving images based on URL parameters, handling both content images and product images.

methods.name: printImage (content image)
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to retrieve content images (logo, content, property) based on store code, image type, and image name.

methods.name: printImage (product image)
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to retrieve product images (small or large) based on store code, product code, image name, and extension.
